propositions: DC Lucene index eventual consistency causes JQL searches to miss recently-created issues, leading recover_pending to unbind valid keyless-pending entries
the unbind at site 1 (recover_pending) enables a duplicate create at site 2 (create_one dedup search) because get_jira_key returns None for keyless-pending entries, invisible to the create gate
fixing only recover_pending is insufficient; the create gate in create_one must defer (not issue) creates while a keyless-pending binding for the local_id is younger than an index-lag grace window
a single negative search must not unbind; unbinding requires both search_miss_count >= 3 AND entry age exceeding grace period (default 3600s)
the grace-window deferral semantics must apply to both DC and Cloud to keep the safe path exercised and prevent vendor-branched correctness divergence
